surfaces.says: The Evry panel the Ask Evry button opens beside any page: ask in words and see what Evry read as cards of linked rows. Each person has their own conversations. The catalog endpoint is listed for completeness: nothing in the app calls it, so no step reaches it.

expect.name: List the people in this church

behaviors.says: A question runs one turn in the signed-in person's own conversation; what Evry read comes back as a card of linked rows from this church only.

AC:INH-REGRESSION-FOREIGN-SESSION AC:TEN-002 AC:SEC-02 AC:UI45-006 INV-tenancy: another account or context cannot read, stream, append, cancel or continue a conversation

behaviors.says: Stop ends a running turn and keeps what was written; Try again reruns only the last turn that did not finish, and a change that did not confirm can be retried once.

tests.name: AC:UI45-001 AC:UI45-002 AC:INH-REGRESSION-SESSION-NAVIGATION AC:EVRY-RETRY-CANCEL AC:INH-CROSS-08 one private conversation, one turn per request key, one active run, cancel and explicit retry
INV-stream-stop INV-stream-end: Stop keeps the partial text and ends the stream promptly
INV-effect-recovery: an approved effect that no worker took within 60 s reads as unconfirmed, not as saving; Try again's job is claimed first and runs it once

surfaces.says: A change Evry prepared, shown in the panel as Review before saving with the exact old and new values: Approve runs it once, Revise replaces it, Cancel ends it. Nothing changes until you approve.

expect.name: List the people in this church

behaviors.says: A change Evry prepares shows as Review before saving with the exact old and new values; Approve runs it once and the page it changed shows the new value.

behaviors.says: Revise replaces the prepared change and voids the earlier approval; Cancel ends it with nothing saved.
